title: Fix the Unhandled Division
description: The program should safely divide two numbers, printing an error message if the divisor is zero. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'Cannot divide by zero' instead of crashing when b is 0.
actualProblem: Dividing by zero raises a ZeroDivisionError that is never caught, so the program crashes instead of handling the situation gracefully.
explanation: Operations that can fail at runtime, like division by a value that might be zero, should be wrapped in a try/except block so the program can respond sensibly instead of crashing.
